name: attack68/rateslib
description: A fixed income library for pricing bonds and bond futures, and derivatives such as interest rate swaps (IRS), cross-currency swaps (XCS) and FX swaps. Contains tools for full curveset construction with market standard optimisers and automatic differentiation (AD) and risk sensitivity calculations including delta and cross-gamma.
